name: Untax
tagline: Property assessment research, VA lookups, and veteran review PDFs
description: Search retained county property assessments, recheck tax-reduction routes, look up official VA facilities and forms, and generate free private Veteran REVIEW/DRAFT PDFs over Streamable HTTP. Exposes 20 MCP tools (`suggest_addresses`, `get_property_assessment`, `recheck_property_opportunities`, `get_owner_workspace`, `get_owner_review_details`, `find_va_facilities`, `get_va_facility`, `find_va_forms`, `get_va_form`, `start_va_connection`, `get_va_connection`, `disconnect_va_connection`, `review_veteran_requirements`, `generate_veteran_packet`, `get_microtransactions_catalog`, `audit_microtransaction`, `get_appeal_lifecycle`, `start_tax_sandbox`, `get_tax_sandbox_order`, `complete_tax_sandbox_order`). Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

install.notes: Public property assessment research and VA facility/form lookups require no account or API key. Private owner reviews, VA verification connections, and test sandbox orders require Untax OAuth 2.1 sign-in.
